capabilities: Search the vault in semantic, keyword, or hybrid mode from a sidebar
Extract text from PDFs, scanned pages, and images with OCR and vision
Transcribe recorded audio into searchable text
Run and manage a vault-local Soma server that syncs hourly
Open results at the matching line in Markdown files
extras: Not yet reviewed by Obsidian staff. Multimedia extraction (OCR, vision, speech-to-text) may need up to 24 GB RAM while active; 8 GB RAM minimum. Desktop only, no mobile. Leaves a .soma index folder in the vault on uninstall; exclude it from sync services.
intentEvidence: Built-in search matches literal text in Markdown. Soma Search adds semantic and hybrid ranking and indexes PDFs, scanned pages, images, and audio.
motivation: Folders are not memory. Memory returns as a phrase, an image, or a half-formed question — rarely as a file path.
problem: Obsidian's built-in search only matches literal text in Markdown, so scanned documents, images, recordings are invisible and fuzzy recall by meaning is impossible.

relations.evidence: Soma — the local-first search engine powering this plugin (semantic, lexical, and hybrid search

summary: Local semantic, keyword and hybrid search over notes, PDFs, scanned pages, images and audio, powered by a locally installed Soma search engine.
